# Impulse Gamer — Australian Fantasy 6-Pack rerelease

- Original title: Fantasy 6-Pack PC Review
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.impulsegamer.com/pcfantasy6pack.html)
- Author / publisher: Andrew B; Impulse Gamer
- Language / date: English; July 2006
- Access: Substantial indexed review text inspected; direct retrieval encountered an encoding error.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

Andrew B reviews an Australian Auran-branded boxed compilation containing Robin Hood, Prince of Qin, Dragon Throne, and three Disciples II titles. The article praises the collection’s value and advertises a historical price of 19.95 Australian dollars.

This documents another distribution context for Robin Hood. The nine-out-of-ten rating belongs to the bundle, not specifically to this game. The page labels Auran as developer and loosely groups Robin Hood with Diablo-like games; those descriptions should not override the original credits or more precise accounts of its tactical gameplay.
